blocks.heading: Unit of Analysis and Protocol
blocks.text: The experimental unit is a formal proof and counterexample search within a restricted classical general relativity model class. This protocol targets a proposed theorem where spherically symmetric stellar collapse with isotropic pressure, global hyperbolicity, and complete null generators are assumed. The design replaces pointwise energy conditions with the Averaged Null Energy Condition (AANEC) and adds an explicit averaged null-convergence/focusing assumption. The AANEC integral is defined as the non-negative accumulation of stress-energy along null geodesics. This formalism is motivated by the necessity of weaker statements for broader validity, as pointwise energy conditions are systematically violated by quantum fields (W3009127927). The unit of analysis remains strictly mathematical; no empirical measurements or numerical simulations are executed.

blocks.heading: Equation Dependency
blocks.text: The equation block above represents the operational definition of AANEC for the null generators $k^a$ tangent to the geodesics $\gamma$. The explicit mathematical form of the additional averaged null-convergence condition (A5) distinguishing it from AANEC remains undefined and requires human input to proceed with the formal derivation.

blocks.heading: Boundary Checks and Decision Matrix
blocks.text:
| Condition | Assumption Dependency | Expected Outcome Branch |
|---|---|---|
| A5 holds for all admissible metrics | Requires formal definition of A5 and Misner-Sharp compactness C | supports_mechanism |
| Candidate witness CE1 evades trapped surface | Requires verification of A5 and A6 stability bounds | null_or_contradictory |
| Numerical verification of Raychaudhuri equation | Requires human confirmation of measurement plan | uninformative_or_invalid |
| Astrophysical mass gap matches bound | Requires separation from explosion energetics confounders | partial_or_heterogeneous |

blocks.heading: Artifacts and Required Human Decisions
blocks.text: Reproducibility of the proposed formal proof depends on the exact specification of the Misner-Sharp compactness parameter $C$ and the averaged focusing condition. Currently, the data governance, measurement plan, and quality control fields require human input. Until these mathematical definitions are resolved, the proof obligations remain unresolved, and the counterexample search cannot yield a definitive scientific conclusion.
